## Construction and theorem application

All new names below have prefix `YulangClosure.WholePublicationResidualR53.`. `assemble` recursively consumes the COMPLETE R50 `(endpoint,decision)` plan and ordered existing R52 `Captured` list. Suppress consumes no call and creates a suppressed R51 Item at its original index; Forward consumes exactly one record and checks the existing R52 `CallSource` for the same publication/index/endpoint/upper/fact/occurrence/slot/cause/returned fields. Missing/extra/reordered/foreign/fact-mismatched records produce `none`. It introduces no new identity system or history.

`assemble_sound` DERIVES `Aligned` from actual successful construction. `Aligned` is not a premise substituting for the target correspondence. By induction over this derived relation, `aligned_projections` proves exact complete item plan, contiguous ORIGINAL indices (`range'`), ordered existing publication/call keys, and planned row/atom suffixes equal the ordered New-only projection of actual records. `forward_has_original_call` and `call_has_original_forward` give both directions of finite Forward/call correspondence; `suppress_has_no_call` proves no retained Forward record occupies a suppressed original index. Together with contiguous indices and R51 `accepted_index_unique`, these supply indexed bijection rather than endpoint matching.

`keyLookup` is a raw owner-list projection; the explicit source `inventory` premise states that the original publication's keyed source table is this exact retained call list. `keyLookup_absent` converts the derived suppress/no-call fact to absent keyed lookup, without assuming suppression ItemReads. Forward source premises are each record's SAME `Installed`, complete `DrainSource`, `ModeSource`, and explicit `NativeSource` current slot/bound/polarity/lane reads. `aligned_item_reads` applies R52 `captured_forward_native` to those same records and derives every R51 ItemReads.

`OwnerReads` uses direct native resultOwner, initialRows and current effectRows projections, plus actual finite take/drop prefix/suffix comparisons against the call projections. It does not assume the target `FrameReads` or final append equation. `owner_frame` uses `List.take_append_drop` to DERIVE exact old-prefix/new-suffix equations and R51 FrameReads. AlreadyPresent contributes no suffix, independently of old emission count. `withItems` retains the same query/context/source fact/publication/row snapshots and installs only the assembled items and their derived suffixes.

`whole_publication_observed` composes the accepted COMPLETE R50 plan, actual assembly, exact owner-list inventory, per-record R52 primitive source/native reads, same artifact, original FactReads and OwnerReads to CONSTRUCT the whole R51 `observe = true`. Neither `observe`, `Reads`, `ItemReads`, `FrameReads` nor the complete target correspondence is assumed. FactReads is an explicit original fact-owner lookup/Catch-port premise; source extraction must supply it.

`CutShape`, `CutOrder`, `CutChain` are numeric reads/checks of original per-call origin/completion/emission cuts in ONE base state. `cut_order_trans` and `adjacent_cuts_compose` construct all-pairs monotone ordering from adjacent owner reads and well-formed individual windows. `same_state_receipts_separate` applies R52 origin/completion separation on the SAME base. `wholeObserve` additionally checks this chronology; `source_whole_observed` derives its acceptance from the same primitive source reads plus the adjacent chain. Parent application is explicit: `whole_observer_components` returns actual assembled items plus accepted R51 observation; `whole_exact_native_frame` immediately applies R51 `accepted_exact_native_frame` and the derived projections to prove exact native initial-prefix plus New-only ordered suffix. `whole_preserves_existing_atom` retains any initial target/sibling.
